note: What a client sends first. It arrives before the connection has a cipher state, so the payload travels in the clear apart from the proof.

fields.name: leading
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. A client emits bytes here that it never wrote for this message, so their content is not a fact about the protocol.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat in the match the sender occupies, counted from zero.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Who the sender claims to be. The proof is what settles the claim.

fields.name: version
fields.note: The build the client runs, with each part written out and run together, so 4.20.0.315 arrives as 42000315. No captured request carries it: what is known of it comes from the answer a server carries back, which repeats the request's own number.

fields.name: proof
fields.note: The player identifier and nothing else, enciphered under the key both ends already hold. Deciphering it and finding the identifier beside it is what shows the sender holds the key.

fields.name: trailing
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. A client emits bytes here that it never wrote for this message, so their content is not a fact about the protocol.
